integrity: Proof by monomiality, graph rotation, explicit holonomy and finite-group splitting; standalone finite calculations are supplementary, not proofs of infinite scope.
scientific_limitations: Cubic weights only; characteristic not two or three; ordinary K-rational automorphism groups. The known six-dimensional nonsplit member is credited as prior. Any implicit broader automorphism-extension theory remains originality risk.
title: Cubic holonomy controls splitting in an infinite family of simple evolution algebras
